name: locum
description: Native Claude Code subagents, and the main session itself, on DeepSeek, GLM, Qwen, Kimi and other models, through the labs' own APIs or OpenRouter; your Claude login stays the default

lowBalanceUsd.title: Low-balance warning (USD)
lowBalanceUsd.description: Show a notice at session start when the OpenRouter balance or key limit is below this. 0 turns it off.

maxRunUsd.title: Spend cap per run (USD)
maxRunUsd.description: An OpenRouter subagent run stops, with a report saying so, once it has spent this much. 0 turns the cap off.

maxSessionUsd.title: Spend cap per session (USD)
maxSessionUsd.description: Once OpenRouter subagents have spent this much in a session, new ones are refused and running ones stop at their next step. 0 turns the cap off.

autoMode.title: Auto mode
autoMode.description: refuse: these agents don't start in auto mode. allow: they run with their tool calls and reports unreviewed by auto mode's safety check (deny rules still apply).

privacy.title: Privacy routing
privacy.description: Which OpenRouter providers may serve these agents. zero-retention: only providers that keep no prompts. no-data-collection: no providers that store or train on prompts. off: any provider.

direct.title: Direct providers
direct.description: Labs to call directly, ahead of OpenRouter, for the models they serve: any of deepseek, zai, dashscope, minimax, comma-separated. Each needs its key in the environment (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, ZAI_API_KEY, DASHSCOPE_API_KEY, MINIMAX_API_KEY). Direct calls skip the privacy routing above. Empty: OpenRouter only.

dashscopeBaseUrl.title: Alibaba Model Studio base URL
dashscopeBaseUrl.description: Your workspace's Anthropic-compatible URL, ending in /apps/anthropic. Empty uses https://dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com/apps/anthropic.

fallbackModel.title: Fallback model
fallbackModel.description: OpenRouter model a step moves to, once, when its agent's own model keeps failing (outage, rate limit, provider error). Never a Claude model.

deepseekModel.title: deepseek: OpenRouter model
deepseekModel.description: OpenRouter model ID behind the deepseek agent.

deepseekEffort.title: deepseek: reasoning effort
deepseekEffort.description: Reasoning budget when the Agent call names no effort.

kimiModel.title: kimi: OpenRouter model
kimiModel.description: OpenRouter model ID behind the kimi agent.

kimiEffort.title: kimi: reasoning effort
kimiEffort.description: Reasoning budget when the Agent call names no effort.

glmModel.title: glm: OpenRouter model
glmModel.description: OpenRouter model ID behind the glm agent.

glmEffort.title: glm: reasoning effort
glmEffort.description: Reasoning budget when the Agent call names no effort.

cheapModel.title: cheap: OpenRouter model
cheapModel.description: OpenRouter model ID behind the cheap agent.

cheapEffort.title: cheap: reasoning effort
cheapEffort.description: Reasoning budget when the Agent call names no effort.

qwenModel.title: qwen: model
qwenModel.description: OpenRouter model ID behind the qwen agent.

qwenEffort.title: qwen: reasoning effort
qwenEffort.description: Reasoning budget when the Agent call names no effort.

minimaxModel.title: minimax: model
minimaxModel.description: OpenRouter model ID behind the minimax agent.

minimaxEffort.title: minimax: reasoning effort
minimaxEffort.description: Reasoning budget when the Agent call names no effort.

customModel.title: custom: OpenRouter model
customModel.description: Any OpenRouter model ID; when set, a locum:custom agent runs on it. Leave empty to turn it off.

customLabel.title: custom: display name
customLabel.description: What the custom agent is called in its description and labels; empty uses the model ID.

customEffort.title: custom: reasoning effort
customEffort.description: Reasoning budget when the Agent call names no effort.
